newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra loses A$49 mln on Foxtel in half-year.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra loses A$49 mln on Foxtel in half-year.

text.p: Government-owned telecommunicaiton group Telstra Corp said on Friday its share of losses from its 50 percent pay television group Foxtel was A$49 million in the six months ended December 31, 1996.
Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd owns the other half of Foxtel.
Telstra is spending about A$3.5 billion on its broadband cable rollout, which carries the Foxtel service.
Blount said Telstra might look at broadcasting the Foxtel service by satellite, under Australia's telecommunications deregulation, which comes into effect on July 1, 1997.
Asked if satellite would be considered to delivery Foxtel, Blount replied: "Yes it is, but that is all I can say."

Blount said Telstra was in talks about a satellite venture, but would not add who with. Telstra's Foxtel partner News Corp is currently in satellite television ventures in Asia, Europe, the United States and Japan, but not Australia.
